tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Application background behind docked panels and between them.

tokens.name: surface-1
tokens.usage: Panel bodies: outliner, properties, problems, build log.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Inputs, raised toolbars, popovers and list rows on hover.

tokens.name: surface-3
tokens.usage: Panel header strips, the active tab and pressed controls.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines between panels and rows; never carries meaning on its own.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, secondary buttons): at least 3:1 on surface-1 and surface-2 in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text, values and labels on ground, surface-1, surface-2, surface-3 and accent-subtle.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: field labels, timestamps, column headers, on surface-1, surface-2 and surface-3.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Disabled text and placeholders only. Below 4.5:1 by intent (disabled controls are exempt); never for information.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Interface accent fill: the primary button, the active tool, the active tab's underline, checked toggles. Text on it is on-accent.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Accent as text: links and references, the content profile badge. Reads on surface-1 and surface-2 in both themes.

tokens.name: accent-subtle
tokens.usage: Selected rows in lists and the outliner; ink reads on it.

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: The 3D view's selection outline and the gizmo handle being dragged (orange, as game-engine editors mark selection in the viewport).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring, 2px solid, offset 1px: at least 3:1 on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: team-1
tokens.usage: Team 1 (US / attackers): spawns, bases, flags held, AI orders. Always with its label or letter; never told from team-2 or the accent by hue alone.

tokens.name: team-2
tokens.usage: Team 2 (RU / NVA / Japan / defenders): spawns, bases, flags held, AI orders. Always with its label or letter.

tokens.name: team-neutral
tokens.usage: Team neutral (TeamNeutral in the data): flags no team holds yet, neutral vehicle spawns. Always with its label (NEU).

tokens.name: unowned
tokens.usage: Gameplay objects no team owns, whose data has no team at all: objectives (M-COMs), combat areas, AI orders. A violet kept apart from team-neutral, the accent, the selection, the teams and the status colours.

tokens.name: status-ok
tokens.usage: A passed check or finished build step. Always with a tick icon or the word.

tokens.name: status-warn
tokens.usage: Warnings: the build continues. Always with its icon or the word.

tokens.name: status-error
tokens.usage: Errors: the build stops. Always with its icon or the word.

tokens.name: status-info
tokens.usage: Information and running steps. Always with its icon or the word.

tokens.name: nav-walkable
tokens.usage: AI workspace: walkable navmesh, drawn at 45% opacity over the terrain.

tokens.name: nav-blocked
tokens.usage: AI workspace: unwalkable regions and coverage gaps.

tokens.name: nav-route
tokens.usage: AI workspace: patrol routes, cross-domain legs and hand-made links (dashed for links).

tokens.name: axis-x
tokens.usage: Gizmo and view axis X.

tokens.name: axis-y
tokens.usage: Gizmo and view axis Y (up).

tokens.name: axis-z
tokens.usage: Gizmo and view axis Z.

tokens.name: view-team-1
tokens.usage: 3D view: what team 1 owns, drawn on the terrain (markers, collision, outlines). At least 3.5:1 on the lit terrain in both themes.

tokens.name: view-team-2
tokens.usage: 3D view: what team 2 owns, drawn on the terrain. At least 3.5:1 on the lit terrain in both themes.

tokens.name: view-team-neutral
tokens.usage: 3D view: team-neutral objects (flags no team holds yet), drawn on the terrain.

tokens.name: view-unowned
tokens.usage: 3D view: gameplay objects no team owns (objectives, combat areas, AI orders), drawn on the terrain.

tokens.name: view-selection
tokens.usage: 3D view: the selection outline (through walls) and the gizmo handle being dragged, on the terrain and the sky.

tokens.name: view-status-ok
tokens.usage: 3D view: a passed check at its object. Always with its tick.

tokens.name: view-status-warn
tokens.usage: 3D view: a warning at its object. Always with its triangle.

tokens.name: view-status-error
tokens.usage: 3D view: an error at its object. Always with its octagon.

tokens.name: view-status-info
tokens.usage: 3D view: information, such as what a level opened without. Always with its circle.

tokens.name: view-link
tokens.usage: 3D view: the selection's links to other objects - references (solid, the arrow at the object referenced) and event connections (dashed, the arrow at the receiver), both ways. Always with its arrow.

tokens.name: view-fx-effect
tokens.usage: 3D view (round VW1): particle effect emitters and their spawn volumes. At least 3.5:1 on the lit terrain and the water in both themes.

tokens.name: view-fx-light
tokens.usage: 3D view (round VW1): dynamic point lights (emitters that act as point lights) and their radius; the light's own colour is its marker's swatch. At least 3.5:1 on the lit terrain and the water in both themes.

tokens.name: view-fx-sound
tokens.usage: 3D view (round VW1): sound emitters with their minimum distance, and sound areas with their outer (fade) edge. At least 3.5:1 on the lit terrain and the water in both themes.

tokens.name: view-nav-main
tokens.usage: 3D view, AI workspace: the main route network's walkable ground (colour by island and by anomaly).

tokens.name: view-nav-ground
tokens.usage: 3D view, AI workspace: NavKit's walkable ground that DICE's file also has (colour by difference), and a file's ground when there is nothing to compare it with.

tokens.name: view-nav-ground-dice
tokens.usage: 3D view, AI workspace: DICE's walkable ground that NavKit's build also has (colour by difference).

tokens.name: view-nav-extra
tokens.usage: 3D view, AI workspace: NavKit's ground DICE's file lacks (colour by difference) and detailed 0.2 m zones (colour by pitch).

tokens.name: view-nav-missing
tokens.usage: 3D view, AI workspace: DICE's ground NavKit's build lacks (colour by difference: its own layer).

tokens.name: view-nav-ladder
tokens.usage: 3D view, AI workspace: ground reached only through a ladder link, and the ladder links.

tokens.name: view-nav-normal
tokens.usage: 3D view, AI workspace: ground of the normal 0.8 m pitch (colour by pitch).

tokens.name: view-nav-dimmed
tokens.usage: 3D view, AI workspace: islands of 25 route nodes or more off the main network (colour by anomaly).

tokens.name: view-nav-small
tokens.usage: 3D view, AI workspace: islands under 25 route nodes (colour by anomaly) and lonely route nodes.

tokens.name: view-nav-outline
tokens.usage: 3D view, AI workspace: the walkable areas' outlines.

tokens.name: view-nav-portal
tokens.usage: 3D view, AI workspace: portals between areas.

tokens.name: view-nav-border
tokens.usage: 3D view, AI workspace: border portals between sectors, and sliver areas (the anomaly overlay).

tokens.name: view-nav-graph
tokens.usage: 3D view, AI workspace: the route graph's edges.

tokens.name: view-nav-route-navkit
tokens.usage: 3D view, AI workspace: the path test's route over NavKit's build.

tokens.name: view-nav-route-dice
tokens.usage: 3D view, AI workspace: the path test's route over DICE's file.

tokens.name: view-nav-edit-add
tokens.usage: 3D view, AI workspace: navigation edits that add ground - walkable regions and seeds.

tokens.name: view-nav-edit-remove
tokens.usage: 3D view, AI workspace: navigation edits that take ground or edges away - unwalkable regions, unseeds, removed route edges.

tokens.name: view-nav-edit-link
tokens.usage: 3D view, AI workspace: navigation edits that join - linked areas and added route edges.

tokens.name: view-nav-edit-mark
tokens.usage: 3D view, AI workspace: traversals, notes and the drawing in progress.

tokens.name: view-ref-ai
tokens.usage: 3D view, AI workspace: a reference level's AI spawners (filled: enabled, outlined: disabled).

tokens.name: view-ref-human
tokens.usage: 3D view, AI workspace: a reference level's human spawners.

tokens.name: view-ref-order
tokens.usage: 3D view, AI workspace: a reference level's AreaOrders.

tokens.name: view-ref-patrol
tokens.usage: 3D view, AI workspace: a reference level's patrol orders, a line through their waypoints.

tokens.name: view-ref-objective
tokens.usage: 3D view, AI workspace: a reference level's objective objects.

tokens.name: view-ref-outline
tokens.usage: 3D view, AI workspace: a reference level's path-data outlines.

tokens.name: view-diff-added
tokens.usage: 3D view, Diff panel: an object only in B (added by the project or the export); on A, a box where it stands.

tokens.name: view-diff-removed
tokens.usage: 3D view, Diff panel: an object only in A (removed in B); on B, a box where it stood.

tokens.name: view-diff-moved
tokens.usage: 3D view, Diff panel: an object in both whose transform differs, and the line from its old place to its new one.

tokens.name: view-diff-changed
tokens.usage: 3D view, Diff panel: an object in both whose other fields differ.

tokens.name: scene-sky
tokens.usage: 3D view: the background behind the map.

tokens.name: scene-terrain
tokens.usage: 3D view: the terrain, lit by the view's light. Dark enough that every view-* colour reads on it.

tokens.name: scene-water
tokens.usage: 3D view: the water surface.

tokens.name: scene-object
tokens.usage: 3D view: placed objects (buildings, props) by their collision; muted so gameplay stands out.

tokens.name: scene-object-destructible
tokens.usage: 3D view: destructible objects (health states or breakable parts).

tokens.name: scene-object-dynamic
tokens.usage: 3D view: dynamic (physics) objects.

tokens.name: scene-object-group
tokens.usage: 3D view: static model group members (rocks, trees, fences).

tokens.name: scene-ladder
tokens.usage: 3D view: ladders.

tokens.name: scene-effect
tokens.usage: 3D view: effect emitters.

tokens.name: scene-area-point
tokens.usage: 3D view: area points (the corners areas are made of).

tokens.name: scene-other
tokens.usage: 3D view: everything else that has a position (logic, sounds, level data).

tokens.name: scene-label
tokens.usage: 3D view: the plate behind a label or a note drawn over the map (surface-1 in Dark, surface-2 in Light, at 85 %); text on it is ink.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Start screen and dialog titles; once per screen.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Moves the flag 12 m north and snaps it to the ground.
styles.usage: Default text in panels, lists, menus and dialogs.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Emphasis inside body text; button labels.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Panel header captions and column headers, set in capitals.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Help text under fields, status bar, timestamps.

styles.name: value
styles.usage: Numbers, coordinates, GUIDs, paths and file names in property grids and logs; tabular figures.

tokens.name: space-0_5
tokens.usage: Icon to its badge; hairline insets.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Inside dense rows; between an icon and its label.

tokens.name: space-1_5
tokens.usage: Control padding block (buttons, inputs).

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Control padding inline; gaps between controls in a toolbar.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Panel inner padding; between field groups.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Between sections of a panel; dialog padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Dialog and start-screen gutters.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Start screen blocks.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, chips, checkboxes, list selection.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, tabs, popovers.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs and floating panels only.

tokens.name: row
tokens.usage: Height of a list, tree, property or problem row.

tokens.name: control
tokens.usage: Height of buttons, inputs and selects.

tokens.name: toolbar
tokens.usage: Height of the top bar and panel toolbars.

tokens.name: panel-header
tokens.usage: Height of a docked panel's header strip.

tokens.name: icon
tokens.usage: Interface icons.

tokens.name: shadow-popover
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, floating panels and dialogs; docked panels have no shadow.
